findings.title: No API for programmatic access to engagement metrics for BI/warehouse ingestion
findings.description: Customer's talent analytics lead needs programmatic API access to BetterBark engagement metrics (active users, session counts, utilization by team/division, trend data) so they can pull it nightly into their data warehouse and serve it through Tableau/Power BI alongside other people-analytics data. Today the only path is manual: the admin screenshots the dashboard and retypes numbers into a spreadsheet. Customer explicitly wants raw data via a plain REST endpoint (not an embedded dashboard or a Tableau-specific connector), at team/division-level aggregate (not individual-level), pulled on a nightly cadence. Business context: enables ROI/retention correlation reporting for an annual people-investment review next Q1, and is described as a factor in the customer's internal renewal advocacy.
findings.quote: What I need is API access to the engagement metrics. Active users, session counts, utilization by team or division, the trend data
findings.severity_reason: Valuable, well-specified feature with clear business impact (renewal case, ROI reporting) but a manual workaround exists today and it affects one account's analytics workflow rather than blocking core product use.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue covers raw-metrics API/warehouse export; distinct from PROJ-118 (PDF export of the dashboard visual, which the customer explicitly says would not meet the need) and PROJ-095 (CSV roster export, unrelated data).

findings.title: Interim scheduled CSV export requested as bridge until API exists
findings.description: Customer asked whether an automatable scheduled export (even CSV) exists today as a stopgap while the full API request is considered, explicitly rejecting a manual-click export as no better than the current screenshot process.
findings.quote: Is there any interim option? Even a scheduled data export we could ingest would be better than screenshots.
findings.severity_reason: Not a separate defect or feature ask; it is a workaround inquiry tied directly to the API-access request raised earlier in the same call.
findings.match_note: Bridge/workaround request for the API-access feature (line 26); not filed as its own ticket per instructions.

findings.title: Customer-side initiative to improve retail banking engagement (not a product ask)
findings.description: Account team mentions retail banking has lower engagement (~60%) than other divisions and that they plan a separate internal push to address it. This is explicitly deferred as a topic for a separate working session and is not a request for any BetterBark product change.
findings.quote: there's a separate push I want to do there but it's not today's topic
findings.severity_reason: Not a product defect or feature request; an internal customer management initiative explicitly deferred to another session.
findings.match_note: No product capability is being requested or reported broken; not comparable to any catalogue issue.
